infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Flyer reads only the photo you pick: a schedule screenshot to add your classes, or a photo to ask Pilot about or send to a friend.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Flyer uses your location while the app is open to sort nearby places by walking time, to check you in at campus spots when you tap "I'm here", and — only if you turn it on — to share where you are with friends you choose.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Flyer adds your classes and due dates to a separate Flyer calendar when you tap Export.
infoPlist.NSCalendarsFullAccessUsageDescription: Flyer adds your classes and due dates to a separate Flyer calendar when you tap Export, and replaces them when you export again.
infoPlist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: This lets ads in Flyer be more relevant. Saying no is fine — you'll still see ads, just less relevant ones. Your schedule, location, and friends are never shared with advertisers.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Only if you turn on Nearby alerts: Flyer checks your rough location in the background, on campus only, to tell you when a friend who also turned it on is close by. Friends never see where you are. Turn it off any time in Friends → Sharing.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Flyer uses the camera to scan a friend's QR code, and to take a photo you choose to send to Pilot or a friend.
